description: This file contains internal helper templates and functions for type introspection, callable checks, and equivalence testing within the Abseil C++ library, specifically related to conformance testing helpers.

classes.name: GeneratorType
classes.description: A template struct representing a function object that returns an instance of a type under conformance testing.

classes.name: EquivalenceClassType
classes.description: A template struct representing a class of generator functions with the same return type, used for conformance testing.

classes.name: IsEquivalenceClass
classes.description: A type trait to check if a type is a specialization of EquivalenceClassType.

classes.name: OrderedEquivalenceClasses
classes.description: A template struct representing an ordered sequence of EquivalenceClassType instances.

classes.name: ResultOfGenerator
classes.description: A metafunction to determine the return type of a GeneratorType specialization.

classes.name: AreGeneratorsWithTheSameReturnType
classes.description: A metafunction to check if multiple generator types have the same return type.

classes.name: AreEquivalenceClassesOfTheSameType
classes.description: A metafunction to verify if multiple EquivalenceClassType specializations contain generator functions with the same return type.

classes.name: If
classes.description: A template struct with a static Invoke method that conditionally executes a callable based on a boolean template parameter.

methods.name: NameOf
methods.description: Returns a demangled, human-readable name of a type.

methods.name: IsNullaryCallable
methods.description: Checks if a function object can be called with no arguments.

methods.name: ForEachParameter
methods.description: Executes a given function on each of its parameters.

methods.name: ForEachTupleElement
methods.description: Applies a function to each element of a tuple.

methods.name: ForEveryTwo
methods.description: Executes a function on every pair of elements in a tuple, including pairs of the same element.

methods.name: InsertEach
methods.description: Inserts multiple values into a container.

methods.name: If::Invoke
methods.description: Conditionally executes a function if the template boolean condition is true.
